dataset: Settles and Meeder (2016), Duolingo shared learning traces, Harvard Dataverse, doi:10.7910/DVN/N8XJME, CC BY-NC 4.0
baseline: Settles and Meeder ACL 2016 author implementation, bias, lexeme and half-life loss enabled, one shuffled pass as upstream
candidate: CatBoost CPU cross-entropy on fractional recall, same pre-session information: elapsed days, past correct, past wrong, learning-language:lexeme
sample: SHA256 of UTF-8 user ID. First uint32 mod 100 < 2 includes all recorded traces for that learner. Second uint32 mod 100 partitions selected learners: <60 train, <70 calibration, <85 dev, else test.
calibration: For each fitted model evaluate raw and sigmoid-recalibrated odds; calibrator fits calibration users only. Select among 8 versions per family on DEV mean learner loss.
primary: Expected binary negative log likelihood using observed within-session recall fraction, averaged first within each learner, then across learners
decision: One planned contrast. Gain >= margin, paired learner-bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0 and two-sided paired sign-flip p < .05. Evaluation within this snapshot only.
